method.onset: 20ms windows/10ms hop in first280ms; unvoiced frication high2kHz>=.35,periodicity<.35,RMS>-45dBFS; preceding voiced windows require lowband>=.60,periodicity>=.60,RMS>-45dBFS.
method.edge: Activity threshold104/32768 (~-50dBFS), exact endpoint samples, clipping samples.
method.limitation: Heuristic source screening, not a listening claim or independent pronunciation approval. Speech onset/tail CTC and per-case review are separate.

terminal_method.voiced_rule: RMS >= -40 dBFS, under-1kHz power >= 0.60, normalized periodicity >= 0.50
terminal_method.periodicity: Maximum normalized autocorrelation, 100-400 Hz; computed only for low-band power >= 0.5 and RMS >= -48dBFS
terminal_method.important_limit: Heuristic screening only. Stop releases, creaky voice and recording conditions can cause false results. Absence of this pattern is not pronunciation approval. Review phoneme ASR and listen separately.

limitations: Heuristic signal evidence requires individual ASR/CTC review; no source modification or full listening is claimed.
